model_meta.system_name: Francis turbine runner with shaped leading edges
model_meta.description: Inferred model of a water-driven Francis turbine runner and the disclosed runner geometry.

subsystems.description: Spindle centered on the runner rotation axis and connected to the crown.
Runner structure rotating with the shaft and joined to the band through circumferentially arranged runner blades.
Circumferential blades between crown and band; outer leading edges admit water and include the disclosed shaped profile.

ports.name: Incoming water at blade leading edges

subsystems.description: Coaxial runner structure coupled to the crown by the blades.
External working fluid entering at the runner blade leading edges and driving runner rotation.

item_flows.name: Incoming water
item_flows.notes: Water enters at the leading edges and drives the runner during operation.

requirements.statement: At least one blade leading edge has a local maximum point between its band and crown connections, with circumferential distance from the band connection largest at that point.
requirements.rationale: Core disclosed leading-edge profile; claims 1 and 5.

requirements.statement: The local maximum point is located at an axial distance P from the band between 0.25B and 0.75B, where B is the band-to-crown axial distance.
During turbine operation, water drives the runner assembly to rotate in the turbine direction.
Where the disclosed local minimum is present on a leading edge, it lies on the crown side of the local maximum.
requirements.rationale: Claims 2 and 6 disclose the optional local minimum and its crown-side relationship.

requirements.statement: At the local maximum point of the cylindrical projection of the leading edge, the first derivative of θ with respect to z is zero and the second derivative is negative.
requirements.rationale: The cited patent passage states these derivative conditions at the local maximum; it does not specify that the negative second derivative holds at least on the band side.

requirements.statement: For the disclosed blade-count parameter Zr, θ1 from the band connection to the local maximum is between (1/32)(360/Zr) and (1/4)(360/Zr) degrees, and the band-to-crown connection angle θ2 has magnitude no greater than (1/4)(360/Zr) degrees.
requirements.rationale: Claims 3–4 and 8–9 disclose these angular bounds relative to blade count.

steps.description: Water enters at the blade leading edges.
Water drives the runner assembly, rotating it about the shaft axis in the turbine direction.
